gait_speed_frailty_cutoff.context: Common gait-speed threshold associated with impaired mobility / frailty risk.
gait_speed_frailty_cutoff.canonical_reference: Studenski S, Perera S, Patel K, et al. Gait speed and survival in older adults. JAMA. 2011;305(1):50-58.

gait_speed_severe_frailty.canonical_reference: Cesari M, Kritchevsky SB, Newman AB, et al. Added value of physical performance measures in predicting adverse health-related events. J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci. 2009;64(7):772-779.

hba1c_target.context: American Diabetes Association HbA1c target for most adults with diabetes.
hba1c_target.canonical_reference: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(Suppl 1).

hba1c_intensive_target.context: Tighter HbA1c target for younger / lower-risk patients.
hba1c_intensive_target.canonical_reference: American Diabetes Association. Standards of Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(Suppl 1).

bmi_overweight.canonical_reference: World Health Organization. Obesity: Preventing and Managing the Global Epidemic. WHO Technical Report Series 894. 2000.

bmi_obese.canonical_reference: World Health Organization. Obesity: Preventing and Managing the Global Epidemic. WHO Technical Report Series 894. 2000.

metformin_standard_dose.context: Common upper-end daily metformin dose for type 2 diabetes.
metformin_standard_dose.canonical_reference: American Diabetes Association. Pharmacologic Approaches to Glycemic Treatment. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(Suppl 1).

ms_to_aging_decline.context: Annual age-related gait-speed decline in older adults.
ms_to_aging_decline.canonical_reference: Bohannon RW. Comfortable and maximum walking speed of adults aged 20-79 years: reference values and determinants. Age Ageing. 1997;26(1):15-19.

grip_strength_sarcopenia_men.context: EWGSOP2 grip-strength sarcopenia cutoff for men.
grip_strength_sarcopenia_men.canonical_reference: Cruz-Jentoft AJ, Bahat G, Bauer J, et al. Sarcopenia: revised European consensus on definition and diagnosis. Age Ageing. 2019;48(1):16-31.

grip_strength_sarcopenia_women.context: EWGSOP2 grip-strength sarcopenia cutoff for women.
grip_strength_sarcopenia_women.canonical_reference: Cruz-Jentoft AJ, Bahat G, Bauer J, et al. Sarcopenia: revised European consensus on definition and diagnosis. Age Ageing. 2019;48(1):16-31.

metformin_complex_i_inhibition.context: Approximate magnitude of metformin's mitochondrial Complex I inhibition.
metformin_complex_i_inhibition.canonical_reference: Owen MR, Doran E, Halestrap AP. Evidence that metformin exerts its anti-diabetic effects through inhibition of complex 1 of the mitochondrial respiratory chain. Biochem J. 2000;348 Pt 3:607-614.

preclinical_lifespan_extension_typical.context: Typical preclinical lifespan extension in metformin animal-model studies.
preclinical_lifespan_extension_typical.canonical_reference: Anisimov VN, Berstein LM, Egormin PA, et al. Metformin slows down aging and extends life span of female SHR mice. Cell Cycle. 2008;7(17):2769-2773.

elderly_falls_prevalence.context: Annual fall prevalence among community-dwelling adults aged 65+.
elderly_falls_prevalence.canonical_reference: Tinetti ME, Speechley M, Ginter SF. Risk factors for falls among elderly persons living in the community. N Engl J Med. 1988;319(26):1701-1707.

all_cause_mortality_diabetes_relative.context: Approximate hazard ratio for all-cause mortality in untreated type 2 diabetes vs general population.
all_cause_mortality_diabetes_relative.canonical_reference: Tancredi M, Rosengren A, Svensson AM, et al. Excess mortality among persons with type 2 diabetes. N Engl J Med. 2015;373(18):1720-1732.

rct_attrition_typical.context: Typical attrition rate in long-duration RCTs of older adults.
rct_attrition_typical.canonical_reference: Schulz KF, Altman DG, Moher D. CONSORT 2010 Statement: updated guidelines for reporting parallel group randomised trials. BMJ. 2010;340:c332.

rapamycin_mouse_lifespan_extension.context: Rapamycin extends median lifespan in heterogeneous mice by ~14% (males) / ~9% (females) when started late in life — the canonical preclinical lifespan-extension number.
rapamycin_mouse_lifespan_extension.canonical_reference: Harrison DE, Strong R, Sharp ZD, et al. Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice. Nature. 2009;460(7253):392-395.

rapamycin_mtorc2_disruption_threshold.context: Chronic rapamycin (sirolimus) dosing beyond ~2 weeks disrupts mTORC2 in addition to its primary mTORC1 inhibition, producing the metabolic side-effects (insulin resistance) that have shaped intermittent-dosing regimens for healthy-aging trials.
rapamycin_mtorc2_disruption_threshold.canonical_reference: Lamming DW, Ye L, Katajisto P, et al. Rapamycin-induced insulin resistance is mediated by mTORC2 loss and uncoupled from longevity. Science. 2012;335(6076):1638-1643.

rapamycin_pearl_intermittent_dose.context: Intermittent (weekly) low-dose rapamycin regimen used in early human aging trials (RAD001 in elderly cohorts; PEARL design lineage). The aging-relevant regimen, distinct from the daily transplant-immunosuppression dose.
rapamycin_pearl_intermittent_dose.canonical_reference: Mannick JB, Del Giudice G, Lattanzi M, et al. mTOR inhibition improves immune function in the elderly. Sci Transl Med. 2014;6(268):268ra179.

rapamycin_therapeutic_trough_post_transp.context: Sirolimus whole-blood trough concentration target in solid-organ transplant immunosuppression — the historical safety envelope clinicians reference when extrapolating to off-label aging contexts.
rapamycin_therapeutic_trough_post_transp.canonical_reference: Kahan BD. Efficacy of sirolimus compared with azathioprine for reduction of acute renal allograft rejection: a randomised multicentre study. Lancet. 2000;356(9225):194-202.
